submission.justification: No project document gives a GWP100 value for any candidate, so the hard GWP ≤ 150 limit could not be checked for any of them. The best time resolution was at 2 mm for all three mixtures. G1 was best at 0.90 ns, G2 gave 1.37 ns and G3 gave 1.87 ns. G1 is the "standard fluorinated mixture". That description suggests a GWP far above 150, though I did not verify it. G2 only partly replaces the fluorinated component, so it probably also exceeds 150. G3 is based on newer replacement gases and is the only candidate likely to comply. I therefore recommend G3 at 2 mm. This is conditional on someone confirming G3's GWP100 from the supplier datasheet. If G3 fails, or if G2 turns out to comply, the fallback is the best-resolution mixture that does comply, also at 2 mm. The cost of choosing G3 is a time resolution about twice as poor as G1's.

requirements.evidence: No document gives GWP values. G3 is described as being based on newer replacement gases, so it is the most likely to comply, but this is unverified.
2 mm chosen. In the simulation, 2 mm gave the best resolution for every mixture, compared with 1 mm and 3 mm.
G3 at 2 mm gives 1.87 ns. This is the best of the likely-compliant options, but G1 reaches 0.90 ns and G2 reaches 1.37 ns. Both are probably non-compliant on GWP, which is unverified.
